taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Semantic response cache reuse across identities and private context
controls.source_trace: Determine whether semantically similar prompts reuse responses generated with another user private context or permissions.
controls.implementation_branch: A vector match threshold determines similarity, not authority. Inspect whether the cache key or post-hit check binds tenant, entitlement, private context and model/tool policy. An intentionally public answer reused across users is a positive control; the material result is another identity receiving a synthetic private answer or action result it cannot independently obtain.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned local cache with synthetic private markers, identical public wording and distinct users; compare cache hit and uncached controls.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Similar model outputs or an answer to public facts is not evidence of cross-user cache reuse without attribution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Scope cache entries to authorized context or public results and retest safe hits plus private-context isolation.
